mapProfile.cameraFraming: Keep the irregular forest boundary and all formation areas readable in the production isometric camera.

styleAuthority.usage: Use the image for visual hierarchy, biome rhythm, and spatial motifs; derive gameplay topology from this semantic contract.

composition.summary: An enclosed woodland composition organized around differently sized clearings, curved routes, terraces, and dense biome-owned edges.
visualHierarchy: A broad lower clearing anchors the scene without becoming a full-width edge strip.
Smaller upper and lateral spaces create distinct staging and lookout opportunities.
Rock, root, and canopy masses frame routes and own the scene boundary.
negativeSpace: Keep navigable breathing room inside clearings rather than along a flat map edge.
Preserve readable gaps around stairs and route forks.
density: Dense forest and rock formations at the perimeter.
Moderate vegetation and landmark density along paths.
Open but irregular interiors within formation clearings.

areas.description: Broad irregular formation area nested inside the woodland boundary.
Smaller elevated staging area with more than one meaningful approach.
Secondary side clearing that creates a route choice and flanking opportunity.
Curved junction where main and secondary approaches remain visually legible.

relationships.kind: terraced ascent with a readable stair connection

landforms: shallow natural basins around clearing edges
connections: Use stairs where a main route changes level.
Use cliffs only where rock or root formations visually explain the boundary.
Do not create isolated single-tile peaks or unexplained drops.

primaryApproaches: Connect the lower clearing to the upper lookout through at least two tactically distinct paths.
Bend primary paths around biome features rather than drawing straight corridors.
secondaryApproaches: Connect the lateral clearing into the main network without making it a dead-end spawn pad.
Include at least one route choice influenced by terrace, rock, or vegetation.

boundaryIntent.description: The biome owns both the rendered and playable edge; avoid a rectangular arena wall or a uniformly cleared perimeter.

spawnIntent.formationCharacter: Two opposing formation opportunities embedded inside clearings, with local cover and multiple exits.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not place candidates on detached pads.
Do not reserve a full-height or full-width cleared spawn strip.
Do not make either side depend on one choke point.
Do not infer exact spawn coordinates from the source pixels.
